prospects.next_action: Qualify the rebrand/product-expansion moment against the 2026-08-01 framework; do not draft unless a current buyer moment, one service route, exact destination, and earned proof asset are verified.
prospects.notes: Current public route includes marketing@seamlesshr.com and Lagos office address on official pages. Treat the rebrand as change evidence, not automatic buying intent.
